description: iSharing iyisitholi somndeni kanye nesitholi sendawo se-GPS esenzelwe ukusiza imindeni ukuthi ihlale ixhumekile futhi iphephile. Yabelana ngezindawo zomndeni zesikhathi sangempela, thola izaziso lapho izingane noma umndeni ufika noma uphuma ezindaweni ezibalulekile, bese usebenzisa i-iSharing njengendlela yokulandelela ifoni ukusiza ukuthola ifoni elahlekile. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhlola ukuthi izingane zakho zifike ngokuphephile, ulandela umndeni usuku lonke, noma uhlangana neqembu, i-iSharing yenza ukwabelana ngendawo kwansuku zonke kube lula. I-iSharing ibilokhu ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwabelana ngendawo kusukela ngo-2010. IZICI ESIZINIKELAYO: ★ Isitholi Sendawo Se-GPS Sesikhathi Sangempela: Yabelana ngasese ngezindawo zesikhathi sangempela nomndeni futhi uhlole indawo yomndeni kumephu. Hlala uxhumekile usuku lonke ngezibuyekezo zendawo ezinembile. ★ Izaziso Zendawo Nezaziso Zomndeni: Thola izaziso lapho izingane noma umndeni ufika noma uphuma ezindaweni ezibalulekile njengekhaya, isikole, noma umsebenzi. Hlala unolwazi ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaphandle kokungena okuphindaphindiwe. ★ Umhlangano - Ukwabelana Ngendawo Yeqembu Lesikhashana: Yabelana ngezindawo zesikhathi sangempela futhi usebenzise ingxoxo yeqembu isikhathi esilinganiselwe ngaphandle kokudala ukuxhumana okuhlala njalo. Joyina ngekhodi ye-QR noma isixhumanisi, bese ukwabelana ngendawo kuphela ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho i-Meetup isiphelile. ★ Thola Ucingo Lwami kanye ne-Tracker Yefoni: Sebenzisa i-iSharing ukusiza ukuthola ifoni elahlekile noma eyebiwe bese ulandela indawo yayo kumephu. ★ Isexwayiso Sokwesaba: Thumela Isexwayiso Sokwesaba esimweni esiphuthumayo ukuze wabelane ngokushesha ngendawo yakho futhi uthumele isaziso se-SOS emndenini. ★ I-Walkie-Talkie: Thumela imilayezo yezwi ngqo nge-iSharing ukuze kube nokuxhumana komndeni okusheshayo nokulula. Udinga usizo? Xhumana nethimba lokusekela le-iSharing ku-contact@isharingsoft.com. * I-iSharing yenzelwe ukwabelana ngendawo futhi kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela ngemvume.
